app.title: OBD2 Scanner
app.tagline: Diagnose and clear your vehicle's fault codes

connect.heading: Connect to your vehicle
connect.description: Plug an ELM327 OBD2 adapter into your vehicle's OBD2 port (usually under the dashboard), turn the ignition on, then connect below.
connect.notSupportedBluetooth: Web Bluetooth isn't supported in this browser. Try Chrome or Edge on desktop or Android.
connect.notSupportedSerial: Web Serial (USB) isn't supported in this browser. Try Chrome or Edge on desktop.

vehicle.heading: Vehicle information
vehicle.offlineNotice: Couldn't reach the online VIN database — showing limited offline info.
vehicle.notConnected: Connect to a vehicle first to read its information automatically.

dtc.heading: Diagnostic Trouble Codes
dtc.clearConfirmBody: This will erase all stored and pending trouble codes and turn off the check-engine light. Only do this after the underlying problem has been fixed, or you may lose evidence needed to diagnose a recurring fault.
dtc.noCodesStored: No stored fault codes. Your vehicle reports no confirmed issues.
